abstract:
BACKGROUND: Early recurrence after radical resection of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is a primary cause of poor prognosis. Published definitions of early recurrence use postoperative cutoff points ranging from 6 to 12 months. This study aimed to analyze perioperative clinicopathological features associated with early recurrence after PDAC surgery, with particular focus on the impact of tumor location, to facilitate individualized treatment decisions.
METHODS: Clinical data from 155 patients with PDAC who underwent pancreatectomy at Panjin Liao-Oil Field Gem Flower Hospital between January 2011 and December 2020 were retrospectively analyzed. In this study, early recurrence was defined as recurrence within 6 months after surgery. Kaplan-Meier method with log-rank test was used to evaluate survival outcomes. Two separate multivariable logistic regression models were constructed to identify independent predictors of early recurrence: one including preoperative variables and one including postoperative variables. Odds ratios (ORs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were reported for these logistic regression models.
RESULTS: The R0 resection rate was significantly higher for pancreatic body/tail tumors than for head/neck tumors (P = 0.040). Among 155 patients, 55 (35.5%) developed recurrence within 6 months (early recurrence group), 78 (50.3%) had non-early recurrence, and 22 (14.2%) showed no recurrence. The early recurrence group had a significantly higher proportion of multiple-organ metastasis (P = 0.019) and significantly shorter overall survival (P < 0.001). No significant differences in recurrence patterns or overall survival were observed between tumor location subgroups (P > 0.05). In the preoperative multivariable model, only CA19-9 ≥ 208 IU/mL was an independent predictor of early recurrence (P = 0.021); body/tail location was not statistically significant (P = 0.123). In the postoperative multivariable model, body/tail tumor location, tumor size ≥ 3.3 cm (based on postoperative pathological measurement), TNM stage III, and lack of postoperative adjuvant chemotherapy were independent risk factors for recurrence within 6 months (P < 0.05).
CONCLUSIONS: In this single-center retrospective cohort, body/tail tumor location was associated with early recurrence within 6 months after curative-intent PDAC surgery in the postoperative multivariable model, but it was not independently significant in the preoperative model and did not significantly affect overall survival. This finding is hypothesis-generating and requires external validation. Incorporating tumor location into preoperative risk stratification may warrant prospective evaluation as one component of a preoperative risk model.

수술 후 다변량 모델에서 췌장 체부/미부 종양 위치, 종양 크기 3.3 cm 이상, TNM 3기, 수술 후 보조 항암화학요법 부재가 조기 재발의 위험 인자였습니다(P < 0.05).
수술 전 다변량 모델에서는 CA19-9 수치 208 IU/mL 이상만이 조기 재발의 독립적 예측 인자였습니다(P = 0.021).
summary_ko: 이 연구는 췌관선암(PDAC) 수술 후 6개월 이내 조기 재발과 관련된 임상병리학적 특징을 분석했습니다. 2011년부터 2020년까지 췌장 절제술을 받은 155명의 환자를 대상으로 후향적 분석을 진행했습니다. 분석 결과 전체 환자의 35.5%가 수술 후 6개월 이내에 재발을 경험했습니다. 수술 후 다변량 분석에서 췌장 체부/미부 위치, 종양 크기 3.3 cm 이상, TNM 3기, 수술 후 보조 항암화학요법 부재가 조기 재발의 독립적 위험 인자로 확인되었습니다.
title: Tumor location in the pancreatic body/tail as an independent risk factor for early recurrence after curative resection of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma: a single-center retrospective study
title_ko: 췌관선암의 근치적 절제술 후 조기 재발의 독립적 위험 인자로서의 췌장 체부/미부 위치: 단일 기관 후향적 연구
